about_the_game:
Recently a large mysterious crystal comet entered the planet's atmosphere, then shattered into thousands of smaller shards that are scattered around the world. Turns out, these crystal shards hold significant power.  Now, large and powerful creatures, roam the world leaving destruction in their paths fighting to expand their territory. If left unchecked, these creatures will destroy everything.

An unlikely duo, magic and science, always had an intense rivalry for as long as anyone can remember. But those days are now behind us. You, along with both departments of magic and science will need to combine your strengths if you hope to have any chance of stop these creatures...

Fight alongside powerful turrets with the help of magic and other technology to bring down these giants!

  • Battle in an immersive atmospheric environment

  • Experience the destructive force of power-infused giants

  • Boss battle gameplay mixed with tower defense

  • Manage resources to request aid in battle

  • Upgrade your arsenal

  • Choose from a variety of heroes to control

name: Titan Star Demo
short_description: Battle massive world-threatening giants. Fight alongside powerful turrets and bring the battle to their front door. Stop the giants and their army's advancement in this boss battle meet tower defense action game. Victory for you means survival for all.
